title: Our 2026 Best New Picks Award Winners | Reviews by Wirecutter
snippet:
If you want to feel the full luxury of mini-split living, the LG Artcool Deluxe KNSAL is easily one of the best options available. This Energy Star–certified AC is more efficient than most other models, and it uses three to four times less energy than the best gas- or oil-based systems, even in subzero conditions. It’s nicer-looking than a lot of other mini-splits, too, with rounded corners and the choice of a white, black, or silver finish. You can even get it with a 12-year warranty, if you [...] Unlike cheesy LED string lights beaming from unsightly plastic coated strips, the LIFX smart lights feature 30 individual lights strung together on a cord. Controllable via Wi-Fi and a simple app, these smart lights don’t require any additional hub or gateway to set up and can shine up to 90 lumens of white light or any other color of your choice. Plus, they’re Matter-compatible, so they can easily integrate with other products. We like that they can attach to a house with an adhesive tab or [...] Of the 11 red-light devices we tested, this was my hands-down favorite. The Shark mask’s user experience is simply exceptional, with the handy (though a tad bulky) remote. It’s an investment, yes, but you get a lot for your money, namely blue-light LED treatment for acne-prone skin, red and near-infrared diodes for signs of aging, and those chilled under-eye pads.

— Rory Evans, appliance editor, previously beauty and personal-care editor
